listing.name: Grand Theft Auto IV (PC 1.0.8.0) / Liberty Pro Max (Awis13)
listing.summary: GTA IV (PC 1.0.8.0) statically recompiled to run natively on Apple silicon Macs and iPads (Apple TV experimental): Metal renderer, the episodes, ~100 fixes, saves through iCloud. Build it from your own copy with the Builder app; no game data included.
